findings.detail: The scene closely repeats earlier question M2-S52-T1 and has the same answer. In both, an extraction system emits findings about a document that people dismiss as false positives. In both, the team wants to analyze which source constructs cause the dismissals so it can fix the prompt, and the answer is to add a detected_pattern field. Swapping invoices for shipping manifests and moving the design to before launch are surface changes only. No wrong option is reused.

blind_answer.reason: Per 4.4-K3/S3, a detected_pattern field recording the source construct that triggered each finding lets dismissals be grouped by pattern. That shows which source formats drive false positives, so the prompt can be adjusted for them. Free-text dismissal reasons are inconsistent and hard to aggregate. A conflict_detected boolean and a calculated_weight field help with self-correction, not with analyzing dismissal patterns.
